issue_title: Investment periods dropped when clustering by busmap
issue_body:
<!-- Please do not post usage questions here. Ask them on the PyPSA mailing list: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/pypsa -->

## Checklist

- [x] I am using the current [`master`](https://github.com/pypsa/pypsa/tree/master) branch or the latest [release](https://github.com/pypsa/pypsa/releases). Please indicate:

## Describe the Bug

When using the spatial clustering functions of PyPSA, investment periods are dropped from the clustered network. I have confimed this bug when using both the `cluster.get_clustering_from_busmap(...)` and `cluster.cluster_by_busmap(...)` methods. The minimal example shown below is created using the clustering examples found [here](https://pypsa.readthedocs.io/en/latest/examples/spatial-clustering.html#Network-Clustering). While investment periods are dropped, the multi-index snapshots are all retained correctly. 

Thank you so much in advance! Please let me know if you require any further information on this bug. 

## Minimal Example

```python 
import pypsa
import re
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

print(f"\nI am using PyPSA verion {pypsa.__version__}\n")

n = pypsa.examples.scigrid_de()
n.calculate_dependent_values()

groups = n.buses.operator.apply(lambda x: re.split(" |,|;", x)[0])
busmap = groups.where(groups != "", n.buses.index)

n.lines = n.lines.reindex(columns=n.components["Line"]["attrs"].index[1:])
n.lines["type"] = np.nan
n.buses = n.buses.reindex(columns=n.components["Bus"]["attrs"].index[1:])
n.buses["frequency"] = 50

# add in investment periods
n.set_investment_periods([2020, 2030])

print("\nCluster by custom basemap\n")

C = n.cluster.get_clustering_from_busmap(busmap)
nc = C.network

print(f"Original investment periods are {n.investment_periods}")
print(f"Clustered investment periods are {nc.investment_periods}")

print("\nCluster by busmap created from K-means\n")

weighting = pd.Series(1, n.buses.index)
busmap2 = n.cluster.busmap_by_kmeans(bus_weightings=weighting, n_clusters=50)
nc2 = n.cluster.cluster_by_busmap(busmap2)

print(f"Original investment periods are {n.investment_periods}")
print(f"Clustered investment periods are {nc2.investment_periods}")
```

```
I am using PyPSA verion 0.28.0

INFO:pypsa.io:Imported network scigrid-de.nc has buses, generators, lines, loads, storage_units, transformers
INFO:pypsa.components:Repeating time-series for each investment period and converting snapshots to a pandas.MultiIndex.

Cluster by custom basemap

Original investment periods are Index([2020, 2030], dtype='int64')
Clustered investment periods are Index([], dtype='object')

Cluster by busmap created from K-means

Original investment periods are Index([2020, 2030], dtype='int64')
Clustered investment periods are Index([], dtype='object')
```
